messages:
alex_marketing: Hey @runtime team — finalizing launch claims and need a compact validation pack for press + webinar. Can you run a focused bench and drop artifacts we can link to?
priya_marketing: Scope: 3 profiles: single-turn interactive demo, webinar load (50 concurrent), and embed batch API. For each we need p50/p95 latencies, throughput, cost/1k tokens estimate, and warmup profile. Also compare quantized vs fp16 on the 8k model.
sam_runtime: Got it. Which input set, region, and hardware?
alex_marketing: Use the demo bundle in s3://redwood/marketing/demo-bundle-v2.json. Region us-west-2. Use the Dedicated pool spec (A100 class). If you must run on an equivalent pool note it.
evan_runtime: Clarify: webinar load — steady 50 or ramp? Embed batch — typical/max batch sizes?
priya_marketing: Ramp 0->50 over 2m then hold 50 for 10m. Embed: typical 8, spike max 64, but please include batch-32 targeted run if variance is high.
sam_runtime: Plan: cold start, warmed run (N=100 warmup), quantized sweep. Produce: perf_summary.csv, raw_traces.tar.gz, example-responses.jsonl (100 samples), and a 1-paragraph methods blurb + curl snippets and RNG seeds. ETA ~18h.
maya_ops: FYI might need to open burst capacity for the Dedicated pool. Ping me before start and I9ll provision.
sam_runtime: Scheduling now. Kicking deploy-bot:
```
/deploy bench-run --bundle s3://redwood/marketing/demo-bundle-v2.json --region us-west-2 --pool dedicated-launch-50 --concurrency 50 --ramp 120 --hold 600 --embed-batch-max 64 --quant-modes fp16,int8
```
deploy-bot: Job queued: bench-run-1765556789-01. Est runtime ~35m. Notifications will follow.
priya_marketing: Please include exact curl/SDK snippets we can paste into the press notes and the model revision hash. Also record tokenization settings and stop sequences.
evan_runtime: Will include deterministic seeds, model hash, kernel/quant flags, and postprocessing notes.
sam_runtime: Run complete. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood/marketing/bench-results/1765556789/. Top-line: p50/p95 and cost estimates in perf_summary.csv. Method blurb: attached in artifacts.
priya_marketing: Quick glance — looks reasonable. Can we do 3 deterministic runs for embed with batch=32 to reduce stdev?
evan_runtime: Yep. We9ll run 3 back-to-back deterministic seeds and report meanu00b1stdev. Schedule?
alex_marketing: Please finish that before tomorrow EOD. Also call out any behavioral regressions in int8 (tokenization artifacts, repetition, output quality) so we don9t overclaim parity. Thanks all :rocket:
